question: Can the G1 (SONIC, MuJoCo) pick and place the block while following the author's recorded hand path (user_demo_v1 demo), at robot pace and at the author's pace?
precheck_before_run: sim/feasibility.py on the raw plan: G1 feasible (all legs IK error <= 2 cm at nominal and 4 jitter corners)
motion: g1/plan_reach.py --demo-plan, frozen g1_contact_v1 grasp calibration (as g1_style_v1)
comparison: g1_style_v1 (person 1, same pipeline): robot pace place 20/30, human pace 0/30
result_v1: 0/30 grasps at robot pace and at the author's pace (touch 13/30, 15/30); block never displaced > 0.2 cm
diagnosis_after_v1: the copied reach starts 3.3 cm BELOW the grasp point and approaches upward (final direction z +0.9; person 1: from 35 cm above, z -0.81): the Dex3 hand reaches the block from underneath at table level. IK error 0 cm, so the kinematic pre-check cannot see it.

followup_v2.condition: safe_path_v2 projection of the same plan (demo.style.safe_project_v2), robot pace
followup_v2.prediction: grasp > 0/30 if the from-below approach is the cause

followup_v3.condition: approach_from_above (demo.style.approach_from_above: safe_path_v2 + the last 40% of the reach replaced by a move to 8 cm above the grasp point and a vertical descent; carry and retreat unchanged), robot pace
followup_v3.prediction: grasp > 0/30 if the sideways table-level approach is the cause; place comparable to person 1 (20/30) would mean the carry style itself transfers

diagnosis_after_v3: raw episodes: closest wrist-to-block distance median 18.1 cm (user) vs 12.3 cm (person 1); the wrist stops 17 cm behind the block in x (person 1: 11.6 cm). The G1 pelvis stands at x = 0.00 in every user run but at -0.08 in person 1's runs, matching the frozen stance offset (-0.075, 0.005) used by the planner -> ~7.5 cm planning error for this demo.

followup_v4.change: planner stance offset set to the pelvis xy measured in the earlier user runs (median of v1-v3 episodes: 0.00, 0.02); everything else frozen
followup_v4.seed_note: new seeds, not used by v1-v3 (the stance value was measured on seeds 100-109)
followup_v4.runner: STANCE='0.0 0.02' SEED0=110 SEED1=119 SEEDS=110-119 DP=... TAG=_userst / _useraboveSt CONDS=nominal bash ~/transfergap_g1/g1/run_style.sh
followup_v4.prediction: grasp and place clearly above 0/30 if the stance mismatch is the cause

followup_v4_note: v4 raw condition: 0/30 grasps; wrist still stops 17 cm behind the block. Planned wrist at the end of the user's reach is 10.3 cm behind the block (person 1: 4.3 cm, and person 1's carry then sweeps the hand 6.8 cm close, scooping the block); the G1 tracks every plan ~7 cm short. The frozen grasp calibration is coupled to the demonstrator's motion.

followup_v5.change: per-demo grasp calibration: forward grasp offset grasp_dxy = (dx, 0) chosen on DEV seeds, everything else as v1 (stance -0.075, 0.005; raw copied path; robot pace)

dev.select: max grasps, then max places, ties -> smaller dx; the choice is committed before the test

followup_v5.runner: GDXY='dx 0' SEED0=.. SEED1=.. SEEDS=.. ROLLOUTS=.. DP=$HOME/transfergap_g1/user_take1.plan.json TAG=_userdx<dx> CONDS=nominal bash ~/transfergap_g1/g1/run_style.sh
followup_v5.dev_result: 0/10 grasps for every dx (touch 2/10 each): no candidate; test stage NOT run (predicted 0/30, would only spend GPU time)
